effective_date_text: announced yesterday the completion of the all-cash acquisition of TA by BP Products North America Inc.
summary: BP Products North America Inc. completed its all-cash acquisition of TravelCenters of America Inc. (Nasdaq: TA) on or about May 15, 2023, with TA common shares converted into the right to receive $86 per share, ending TA's status as an independent publicly traded company. The supplied sources directly document the delisting of TA's separately listed senior notes (TANNI; TANNL; TANNZ) from Nasdaq, with an expected notes-delisting effective date on or about June 5, 2023, following a Form 25 filing on or about May 26, 2023. However, none of the supplied passages contain a Nasdaq notice or Form 25 filing specific to the TA common stock listing itself; the common stock delisting is inferable only from the acquisition-completion language and the standard practice of common shares ceasing to trade upon merger closing, not from a direct exchange notice for the common stock CUSIP/symbol.
unresolved_conditions: No source passage directly documents a Nasdaq Form 25 or delisting notice specifically for TA common stock (as opposed to the senior notes); the exact effective date/time TA common stock itself stopped trading on Nasdaq is not confirmed by a primary exchange or SEC filing in the supplied evidence.
Confirmation of Form 15 deregistration filing date for TA common stock under Exchange Act Section 12(g) is not independently verified in the supplied sources.
